lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the shadow of the mountain peak,
The silent echoes of the ages speak.
A crown of gold upon a weathered stone,
Where ancient secrets rest on a frozen throne.
[Pre-Chorus]
The winds of fate begin to rise,
Beneath the arch of heavy, silver skies.
[Chorus]
Rise like the tide, bold and free,
Carried by the spirit of the sea.
One heart beats for the land of old,
In a story of iron and gold.
[Verse]
Through the valley where the rivers run,
Under the gaze of a dying sun.
Every footprint tells a tale of pride,
With the strength of mountains deep inside.
[Pre-Chorus]
The drums of time begin to beat,
Where the earth and heaven meet.
[Chorus]
Rise like the tide, bold and free,
Carried by the spirit of the sea.
One heart beats for the land of old,
In a story of iron and gold.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
From the ashes of the fire's glow,
Where the seeds of destiny did grow.
[Chorus]
Rise like the tide, bold and free,
Carried by the spirit of the sea.
One heart beats for the land of old,
In a story of iron and gold.
[Outro]
